approval: Owner approved HF uploads for experimentally working models with licenses preserved (2026-10-27). The precision is chosen per dispatch from the recipes below.

license_file.note: The model repository declares license: mit in its card but ships no LICENSE file; the verbatim MIT text is taken from the upstream code repository at a pinned commit.

Q4_K_MIX.note: Named policy unlimited_ocr2_q4k_shared8_v1 (docs/unlimited-ocr2-q4k-recipes.md): routed experts and decoder attention Q4_K, expert ffn_down IQ4_NL (896-wide, no Q4_0), shared experts Q8_0, SAM/CLIP vision, embedding and lm_head Q8_0, c.pos_embed and v.pos_embed F16. 2,189 MiB vs 3,397 MiB Q8_0. Final-logit cosine min 0.9634 (hosted CPU, portable) / 0.9540 (CUDA T4) on all four frozen cases; free-running decoding differs from the original only in box coordinates (max 2 px), text with boxes stripped equal on 4/4, every case reaches EOS.

qualification.receipts_precision: F32 lossless conversion; other precisions are covered only by the separate precision sweep
qualification.registry_alias: follow-up after upload; real SHA256 required

card_quality.status_md: **Status per file.** F16 is **recommended** (token-ID exact against the original on all four tiled trial pages). Q8_0 carries a **caveat** (box-coordinate tokens differ by 1-3 on 2 of 4 tiled pages; text unchanged; CUDA final-logit cosine 0.9555 is below the 0.97 Q8_0 bar). **Experimental: Q4_K_MIX** - it clears the owner's Q4_K final-logit cosine bar (> 0.94) on CPU and CUDA, but is not token-ID exact on any of the four cases; the recognized text matches F16 only after layout boxes are stripped.
